notes: Scored at coverage level, and also blocking-eligible at P2 — asserted_only blocks at P2 and above.

source.reference: Stubbing the collaborator whose behaviour the criterion is about. The dedup criterion is proven against a mock that answers correctly while the real hasCapture always returns false

defect: ac_2 requires a retried capture to charge once. The test mocks the store so hasCapture answers truthfully; the real hasCapture always returns false, so every retry captures again.
why_it_is_hard: The test is a good test of capture()'s logic and a useless test of the criterion. The lie is in store.ts, unchanged by the diff, three lines under a comment that reads like an implementation note.
